resources.string: LogDate couldn’t open your saved journal. Try opening it again.
Android’s transfer did not finish. LogDate has kept the received files untouched and has not opened the journal. Finish device setup, then try again.
LogDate kept your restored journal. It couldn’t finish checking transferred media, so it hasn’t opened the journal. Tap Try again to safely continue recovery.
LogDate needs more free space to finish opening your journal. Free some space, then tap Try again.
This journal was saved by a newer version of LogDate. Update LogDate on this device to open it. Your journal and encryption key have been kept safe.
Update link copied. Open it in a browser to update LogDate.
Recover from LogDate Cloud or an archive. LogDate keeps the encrypted journal protected on this device.

Your journal is here, but its privacy settings weren’t restored. LogDate has kept it protected. Update LogDate on your original device, then repeat the Android transfer or restore a complete device backup. When it finishes, tap Try again.
